findings.text: The rules flow is this: "agent.kurallar.md" → "rules.master.agent" → note → agent cards. All three arrow ends and directions were seen in the image.
One rules file feeds one orchestrator. No version, approval or change record for the rules file is visible in these cells. A rules change could quietly change all agent behavior.
"test-first.agent" writes the tests. The same orchestrator also manages the coding agents. No independent check of the tests is visible here. Dot's item 16 and item 32 point to the same risk.
"task-dependency-cluster.agent" groups tasks by dependency. No rule is visible for what happens when a dependent input changes. Dot's item 14 says that acceptance must then be checked again.
These cells give no limit for orchestrator capacity, time or budget. They also give no recovery path after an outage. These are open questions, not proven gaps. The rest of the page may answer them.
The text layer does not cover the same area as the image. A text-only review would mark visible card texts as missing.
